dedupe_keys.name: legger en werkingsgebieden waterkeringen vastgesteld waterschap rivierenland

description: Legger en Werkingsgebieden Waterkeringen Vastgesteld Waterschap Rivierenland is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by portal.wsrl.nl. The Rivierenland Water Board records essential information that the dikes (water barriers) must meet in terms of location, size, shape and construction in the layer. This map layer contains the established layer of the flood defences of the Rivierenland Water Board. These were adopted on 2 September 2025. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Legger and Areas of Operation Water Barriers Determined Water Board Rivierenland" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Werkingsgebieden, Legger, Waterkeringen. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2025-09-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/4.0/deed.nl). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
